verdict.rationale: Devin's docs and CLI clearly position it to take plain-language tasks (tickets, bug fixes, new features) and implement changes autonomously across a repo (devin-docs-1, devin-docs-3, devin-docs-4, devin-docs-5), but hands-on community reports directly contradict smooth multi-file autonomous delivery: reviewers found it 'always adds extraneous changes beyond the task that can break other things, and can't undo those changes if asked,' concluding it wasn't actually saving time despite cost (devin-comm-1), while other users only got value by constantly supervising and terminating bad sessions (devin-comm-5). missing for 10: independent benchmark or case study confirming reliable multi-file correctness, resolution of the 'extraneous changes' failure mode, and evidence the described capability works without heavy human babysitting.
